unlisted_practices: Risk-aware policy optimization with patient-specific reference prototypes to calibrate drug safety boundaries in LLM medication recommendation
Fine-tuning LLMs on synthesized reasoning trajectories grounded in graph retrieval of patient-specific knowledge

screen.reason: The paper presents RES-MR, a new LLM training framework for explainable and safe medication recommendation evaluated on benchmark datasets. It represents model architecture/training development rather than testing organizational deployment practices or guardrails on existing tools.
